# Terse

> Terse is an on-device AI agent butler for macOS and Windows that cuts AI token costs by 40-70%. It compresses prompts before they hit the API, live-monitors 8 coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cline, Windsurf, OpenClaw, Aider), enforces spending limits with a budget circuit breaker that can pause or kill a runaway agent before its next API call, manages MCP servers with security risk scoring, and diagnoses token waste with Terse Doctor. It runs 100% on-device with zero cloud dependency — prompts never leave your machine.

## Key Facts
- Reduces token usage by 40-70% on verbose prompts and up to 89% on CLI output
- 35+ optimization techniques in a 7-stage on-device pipeline (<5ms)
- Auto-detects 8 agents: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cline, Windsurf, OpenClaw, Aider
- Budget circuit breaker: burn-rate / token / dollar ceilings that escalate from alert to pausing (SIGSTOP) or killing (SIGTERM) the agent process before the next API call
- MCP Manager: discovers every MCP server across Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf configs; risk-scores each (remote transport, embedded credentials, code-execution surface, unpinned supply chain); enable/disable without editing JSON
- Terse Doctor: ~25 consent-gated scans — prompt-cache waste (low hit rate, write thrash, TTL expiry), MCP bloat, duplicate tool calls, redundant file reads, context burn, CLAUDE.md token tax, secret exposure, runaway runtimes, disk cleanup — with one-click fixes
- Per-session stats: input/output tokens, cache read/write efficiency, per-turn cost with model-aware pricing, burn rate, context-window fill %
- Alert Center: 9 alert kinds via macOS/Windows notifications, Slack webhook, or ntfy.sh push; weekly savings digest
- Model-aware pricing: tracks costs for Claude Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5
- 400+ built-in typo corrections, 130+ phrase-shortening rules
- 3 modes: Soft (typo-fix only), Normal (filler removal), Aggressive (max compression); code blocks always protected
- Team sharing: publish live agent sessions and aggregate stats to teammates, including via an MCP server their agents can query
- Also available as a Chrome extension (in-page compression for any AI chat) and a VS Code extension (agent monitoring + optimizer in the editor)
- Pricing: Free (50/week), Pro $4.99/mo (unlimited, 30-day free trial), Premium $99/mo (teams)
- macOS + Windows, built with Tauri + Rust + Swift

## Pricing
- Free: 50 optimizations/week, 1 session, all 3 modes, spell correction
- Pro ($4.99/mo): Unlimited optimizations, 3 sessions, agent monitoring, CLAUDE.md generation, 2 devices, 30-day free trial
- Premium ($99/mo): Unlimited everything, unlimited devices, priority support, 30-day free trial
